title: A keep scalar that is one line of spaces with no final line break is replaced whole
notes: The line of spaces belongs to the scalar (value `\n`, yaml-test-suite JEF9, third input), so it goes with it; `- 5` followed by a line of spaces is the same document but not the minimal edit (docs/edit-semantics.md, Kit conventions). A final line break the input did not have stays missing. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend left the line of spaces after the new item.
